725f1059bf1d33dfae34ada33a29249761aca93d.en: Jenny Eurell and Oscar Hult met for the first time at a songwriting session in 2022. Both had a passion for music since childhood. Jenny had been singing for as long as she could remember but started writing songs in 2014 when she attended a folk high school. She released music in various projects until she realized that Swedish poetry was more her style, and she fell in love with Swedish pop.Oscar played the guitar as a teenager but traded his guitar for his computer when he discovered the magic of the more electronic sounds of house music. In 2016, he signed with a major record label under the artist name Lefree and released, among other things, the hit Gold Digger, which has been streamed millions of times. Over time, he began listening more to Swedish pop, and a desire to form a pop group was born.

bccd15771b6b9b482f0d1ee56af1b03399577920.sv: Vi flyttar tyst uppmärksamheten – och beteendet.
